subject: geography
title: People of the UK: Change

concepts.def: Over 18% of UK residents are aged 65+ and rising.
Children plus older people compared to working-age adults.
Movement into or out of a place to live.
2004 expansion led to large Polish migration to the UK.
UK left the EU on 31 January 2020, changing migration rules.
South generally wealthier than the North, with exceptions. 🚶

walkthroughs.body_html:
The UK is getting older.

Over 18% are aged 65+ and the share keeps rising.

This stresses the NHS and pension system.

Migration is reshaping the population.

The 2004 EU enlargement brought hundreds of thousands of Poles.

After Brexit in 2020, EU arrivals fell but non-EU rose.

Wealth is not even.

The North-South divide shows higher incomes in the South East.

Areas like Manchester still buck the trend with thriving services.
